source.content: ApexPages.Action action = new ApexPages.Action('list'); System.assertEquals('list', action.getExpression()); ApexPages.Component root = new ApexPages.Component(); System.assertNotEquals(null, root); root.childComponents = new List<ApexPages.Component>{new ApexPages.Component()}; root.componentIterations = new List<ApexPages.ComponentIteration>{new ApexPages.ComponentIteration()}; root.id = 'root'; root.expressions = 'expr'; root.facets = 'facet'; root.rendered = false; System.assertEquals(1, root.childComponents.size()); System.assertEquals(1, root.componentIterations.size()); System.assertEquals('root', root.id); System.assertEquals('expr', root.expressions); System.assertEquals('facet', root.facets); System.assertEquals(false, root.rendered); ApexPages.Component child = new ApexPages.Component(); child.id = 'child'; child.parent = root; System.assertEquals('child', child.id); System.assertEquals(root, child.parent); ApexPages.ComponentIteration iteration = new ApexPages.ComponentIteration(); iteration.childComponents = new List<ApexPages.Component>{new ApexPages.Component()}; iteration.iterationValue = 'row'; iteration.parent = root; System.assertEquals(1, iteration.childComponents.size()); System.assertEquals('row', iteration.iterationValue); System.assertEquals(root, iteration.parent);
